description: Your pitch deck coach: sharper headlines, a clearer story and the 3 fixes investors would ask for.

defaultPrompt: Does my storyline make sense? Run the headline test on my deck (upload deck)
Play devil's advocate on my value proposition slide (upload slide)
Which metric should I lead my traction slide with at seed, and how should I show it?
interface.longDescription: A pitch deck coach for founders raising pre-seed, seed and Series A, built by Ivan Landabaso. Share a deck or a single slide and get specific feedback organised around the four questions investors ask: do I get it, is it real, can it be huge, is it them? It rewrites weak headlines line by line, checks your storyline, plays devil's advocate, helps you show traction at your stage, and points to how famous decks like Airbnb, Uber and Notion solved the same problem.
